source.freeze_validation: All 13 listed files match the tested frozen after tree. The standalone microbenchmark was added after the unit jobs; production/test files were not overwritten while jobs used them.

implementation.normalization: Existing row_logsumexp for CUDA FP16/BF16/FP32, with FP32 accumulation and absolute FP32 max+log_sum output. CPU/other float dtypes retain Torch normalization.
implementation.selection: Unchanged torch.topk(k=128), raw values and int32 vocabulary IDs; no small-k fused selector is used.
implementation.ownership: Owned outputs on the calling stream before serving-side mutations. Full-vocabulary padded columns excluded.
implementation.startup: One FP32 vocabulary row warmed during target-contract binding, including P/D prefill. Current device stream synchronized at startup only; failures use the existing binding vote before Store connection.
implementation.scope: No Store or wire protocol changes, no new hot-path synchronization, no changed loss or teacher-value semantics.

microbenchmark.scope: Complete teacher extraction including top-k, LSE, conversions and optional row selection. Eager host wall time includes dispatch and final synchronization. Batched CUDA-graph event time amortizes host submission; neither is serving latency. No Store, D2H or Catalog work is included.
microbenchmark.warmup_limit: Shared Triton cache was already used by probe/unit tests; not a clean-cache or startup SLA measurement.
microbenchmark.topk_comparison: All IDs and raw values exact; LSE rtol=atol=1e-6.
microbenchmark.raw_observations: All repetitions are retained in the hashed raw report and job log.

preliminary_probe.scope: 24 LSE-only cases, FP32/BF16, three vocabulary sizes and four row counts. CUDA-event intervals around CPU-fed loops include launch gaps. Superseded for performance conclusions by complete extraction measurements.

verification.formatting: Five Python files pass Black/I/F. New/other changed files pass full Ruff; coordinator has only nine baseline BLE001 findings.
verification.numerical: FP16/BF16/FP32, stride/padding/boundary/empty/duplicate-row/FP64-fallback, offsets and nonfinite rows; FP64 sum of FP32 scores reference at rtol=atol=1e-6.
verification.lifecycle: CUDA source reuse, stream/tail fences, graph replay, Gloo startup and cohort cleanup, compile-failure callback before Store, full actual AR/static/ragged DSpark/lifecycle and actual P/D faults/cancellation/post-exit reads.
verification.serving_checks: All four measured capture-on phases: admitted=READY=readback=50, no admission backpressure/Catalog error/quarantine; all four fields of 13 stages match real Prometheus scrapes. Normal stage counts equal publications, catalog_written=2x, recovery_read=0, errors=0.

remaining_gates: Production target model and TTFT/TPOT/throughput limits are not specified
Representative serving SLO acceptance and balanced longer measurements
Production Catalog/consumer integration and trained draft quality

serving_interpretation.conclusion: Microbenchmark gains do not establish an end-to-end serving speedup. Tails vary and the first baseline off bracket drifts by 11.19%; capture-on retains only 69%-72% of off throughput. Production SLO acceptance remains open.
